subject: Epoch Health — packaging restructure & one-off onboarding credit request
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Epoch Health - packaging ask summarised for VP/CFO review

Marissa / Aditya — quick summary and ask. Epoch (Lara Dunn) has submitted a request that crosses our standard commercial guardrails and needs VP/CFO sign-off. Key points: 

- Request: a blended tier for their multi-product deployment (Embeddings + chat) and a one-off onboarding credit to offset migration costs.
- Commercial ask: 40% unit discount on chat tokens for first 6 months + $45k one-time onboarding credit. They want the blended price applied to a combined committed MRR basis.
- ARR / revenue: forecasted ARR if they commit = ~$1.1M ARR. The first-6-months concession reduces near-term revenue by ~ $135k; lifetime deal impacts depend on renewal behavior.
- Rationale: They are moving three product teams into Redwood and committing a 12-month consumption floor; strategic reference in the payer vertical (they named a consortium pilot). They asked for faster SSO + SOC evidence (we have that in the portal).
- Comp Risk: Customer asked to include a clause allowing a pricing reset if their usage is < 40% of committed volumes in months 4–6.

Attached: proposed SOW v2 and a pricing model I ran (packaging-models.xlsx). My recommended compromise: approve a 30% discount on chat for the first 6 months (instead of 40%), approve the $30k onboarding credit (not $45k), and require a minimum first-month usage floor and a Q4 early-termination clawback pro-rated. This limits downside but keeps the commercial momentum.

Ask: Can we get VP/CFO sign-off on the recommended compromise (30% / $30k / usage floor + clawback)? If yes, I will lock terms with legal and push final SOW to Epoch and route DocuSign.

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Strategic Accounts (acting)
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Epoch_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), packaging-models.xlsx (xlsx)

If you want a deeper look, the attached model shows P&L impact at multiple conversion scenarios.

Subject: RE: Epoch Health - packaging ask summarised for VP/CFO review

Thanks for the clear write-up. I have reviewed the model and the strategic ask. Decision: APPROVE with constraints.

Approved items:
- Promotional discount: 30% off chat unit price for first 6 months only. No extension without renewed exec approval.
- One-time onboarding credit: $30,000 (to be applied against first invoice).

Required conditions (must be reflected in SOW/COGS/Rev recognition):
1) Usage floor: customer must hit at least 60% of the agreed consumption in month 1 and 75% average across months 1–3, otherwise the credit is clawed back pro-rata on month 4 invoice.
2) Pricing reset clause: if usage remains < 60% by month 6, Commercial has the right to reset to standard published rates for months 7+.
3) Legal to add a 90-day audit clause and a trial-period termination clause with pro-rata reconciliation.

Rationale: Approve enough to keep momentum and capture the reference, but guard revenue through floors and clawbacks. This should be documented in a redlined SOW and a short amendment for pricing terms.

Marissa/Olga: Proceed to Legal and Procurement for final wording and get DocuSign link turned around. Aditya: please update the HubSpot deal with the approved concession details and expected closed date.

-Markus
CFO, Redwood Inference
